about: Event mode for this atlas (deploy/apply-event-mode.mjs, deploy/refresh-event-atlas.mjs). Spec by Fable, approved by Mithun 2026-10-22, with his overrides: at most 8 eat-and-drink places per venue, nearest first; the Vivanta venue is Vivanta Goa, Panaji (renamed, Campal address); Kala Academy's picture from its Wikipedia page; the Cafeteria's sessions merged into Kala Academy, which is the venue. 23 Oct 2026: one chip at a time; See & Do (Fable's call, Mithun's yes) replaces Art & Culture with parks, views, beaches, landmarks, museums, galleries and markets in four headings, churches and temples only when the data marks them notable; Utils renamed Essentials; What's around here opens Eat & Drink.

merges.why: Mithun, 2026-10-22: merge the Cafeteria into Kala Academy; Kala Academy is the venue.
